title: Analysis code for: Joint Exposure to Wildfire Smoke and Extreme Heat and Wearable-Measured Sleep Characteristics Among US Adults
description: Analysis code, software-environment records, and the dated analysis plan for a time-stratified self-matched (case-crossover) study of wildfire smoke, extreme heat, and their joint occurrence in relation to wearable-measured sleep among adults in the All of Us Research Program (Controlled Tier curated data repository v9, 2016-2023). The repository contains no participant-level data and no All of Us data of any kind; All of Us data are available to authorized users through the Researcher Workbench.
